value.rationale: The first nontrivial two-point type obstruction in the generic Fano-free hypergraph is a mathematically canonical finite boundary. The exact type count and full mutual-link law show how a single old overlap breaks free pair-extension while every one-point type remains unconstrained. The isolated biased coordinate and explicit total-variation separation identify a structural logical effect, not just a size exclusion or known Fano-plane census.
